_instructions: Edit this file with YOUR real records only.
Run: docker compose exec backend python -m app  (or: python -m app from backend/)
The seeder is idempotent — safe to rerun. It upserts by title (incidents) and email (users).
Passwords for seeded users can also be set via env vars: SEED_DBA_PASSWORD, SEED_ANALYST_PASSWORD, SEED_VIEWER_PASSWORD
report_logs are measured from the live DB at seed time — row_count will reflect actual incident data.

users.note: You — lead DBA. Password set via env var or derived from SEED_PASSWORD_SALT.
Analyst role — report runner, incident creator.

incidents.title: FEATURE: Seed demo data CLI for local reset
incidents.description: Implemented idempotent python -m app seed command. Loads users, incidents, and report logs from seed_data.json. Volume-mounted for live edits without container rebuild. Verified in Docker Compose.
